name: cfa-pro
description: [FREEMIUM + PAID] cfa-pro MCP plugin — premium market-data feeds for CFA workflows. Bundles two MCP servers: (1) fmp-market-data (Financial Modeling Prep, freemium, requires FMP_API_KEY) for 180 tools covering quotes, financials, screening, institutional ownership, technicals; and (2) vendor (paid subscriptions required) covering LSEG, S&P Global, FactSet, Morningstar, Moody's, PitchBook. Skills for each vendor included.
